title: 휴대폰 청구서 읽기: 얼마를, 언제까지 내요?
objective: By the end, you can read a Korean mobile phone bill and find the total amount, the due date, the payment method, and the main charges and discounts.
summary: Learners read a monthly mobile phone bill and find the amount to pay, the due date, and what each charge is for.
note: This bill is an example. The company, names, and numbers are made up.

task.title: Read the bill and answer
task.line: Use the bill in section 1 and the word list to answer each question.

sections.heading: 1. 휴대폰 요금 청구서 (2026년 8월분)
paragraphs: 납부 기한: 2026.09.25 / 납부 방법: 자동이체 (은행 계좌)

items.text: This is the total money you must pay this time.
items.example: 이번 달 청구 금액이 지난달보다 많아요.

items.text: These are the dates when you used the phone for this bill.
This is the plan you chose, for example how much data you get.
You pay this fixed fee for your plan every month.
This is part of the phone's price, paid a little each month.
items.example: 휴대폰을 새로 사서 단말기 할부금이 있어요.

items.text: These are extra services you pay more for, on top of your plan.
This money is taken off your bill and has a minus sign (-).
This is money you did not pay before. It is added to this bill.
This is the last day you can pay without problems.
The money leaves your bank account by itself on the payment day.

sections.heading: 3. Reading tips
paragraphs: First, find 이번 달 청구 금액. This is the number you pay. Next, find 납부 기한 to see the last day to pay. 8월분 means the bill is for what you used in August, so it usually comes in the next month.
A minus sign (-) means money is taken off. If 미납 금액 is not 0원, you missed a payment, and that money is added to this bill.

exercises: Look at the bill. Answer in Korean with the number: 이지은 씨는 이번 달에 얼마를 내야 해요?
Look at the bill and answer in Korean: ① 언제까지 내야 해요? ② 어떻게 내요?
Choose the right word: ① 휴대폰 값을 한 번에 안 내고 매달 나눠서 내요. (기본료 / 단말기 할부금) ② 음악, 영화 같은 서비스를 돈을 더 내고 써요. (부가서비스 / 요금제)
Look at the bill. Write O if it is true and X if it is false: ① 요금을 10,000원 할인받았어요. ② 지난달에 안 낸 돈이 있어요. ③ 이 청구서는 8월에 쓴 요금이에요.
Fill in the blank with a word from the list: 지난달 요금을 안 냈어요. 그래서 이번 청구서에 ____ 금액이 15,000원 있어요.
answers: ① 2026년 9월 25일까지 (9월 25일까지) ② 자동이체로 내요. (은행 계좌에서 나가요.)
① O ② X ③ O
